sources.title: r/LocalLLaMA on Reddit: [Megathread] Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - Release Day
How to Run Qwen3.8 Flash Next Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks - Atomic Chat
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 Flash Next is the first open model built on the Qwen4 architecture that you can run locally: a 125B Mixture-of-Experts model that activates 6B parameters per token and runs from a 64 GB MacBook up, with its 51B n-gram table paged from SSD. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.
